title: Whispers of the Unseen City
lyrics:
Verse 1:
Dusty roads behind me, a map creased in my hand.
Old familiar comforts, now a distant, fading land.
Sunrise paints the highway, with colours soft and deep,
A quiet hum within me, secrets I will keep.
The engine's steady rhythm, a pulse against the grey,
Carries me to futures, so many miles away.

Chorus:
Oh, city of new whispers, a silhouette so grand,
A tapestry of stories, I long to understand.
Each brick a silent promise, each shadow a soft gleam,
Am I truly ready for this vibrant, waking dream?

Verse 2:
Through bustling streets I wander, a stranger to this pace,
New faces, hurried footsteps, a smile on every face.
The coffee shop aroma, the distant church bells chime,
A different kind of cadence, defying space and time.
From a window, high above me, a melody takes flight,
Inviting me to listen, and bask within its light.

Chorus:
Oh, city of new whispers, a silhouette so grand,
A tapestry of stories, I long to understand.
Each brick a silent promise, each shadow a soft gleam,
Am I truly ready for this vibrant, waking dream?

Bridge:
A little fear unwinding, a hope that starts to bloom,
No longer just observing, I step into each room.
The courage found in silence, the strength within my stride,
This new beginning beckons, nowhere left to hide.

Outro:
And as the evening settles, soft lamplight through the haze,
I feel a quiet grounding, through these unfolding days.
This city calls me closer, with every breath I take,
A brand new life is waiting, for goodness gracious sake.
music_prompt: Ambient folk track at 80 BPM in A minor. Features a fingerpicked acoustic guitar as the foundation, supported by a warm upright bass providing a gentle, grounding rhythm. Long, sustained cello lines add a melancholic depth and soaring texture. Soft, echoing piano arpeggios weave throughout, creating a spacious and reflective atmosphere. Subtle, airy pads swell and recede, contributing to the atmospheric backdrop. Percussion is minimal and delicate, utilizing soft brushes on a snare and mallets on a distant tom, maintaining a gentle, flowing pulse. Vocals are expressive and breathy, with a clear, intimate delivery, building to a slightly more resonant and hopeful tone in the choruses, then returning to a reflective hush for verses and bridge.
cover_prompt: Cinematic widescreen artwork. A solitary figure stands on a high vantage point, back to the viewer, gazing out at a vast, softly lit city sprawling into the distance at dawn or dusk. A gentle mist or low-lying fog partially obscures the city's intricate details, adding a sense of mystery and newness. The sky is a gradient of muted purples, soft oranges, and deep blues. Foreground elements like rugged rocks or sparse, silhouetted trees subtly frame the composition. The song title 'Whispers of the Unseen City' is subtly yet clearly readable in an elegant, non-obtrusive sans-serif font, integrated seamlessly into the upper third of the image. The overall composition is strong and balanced, with no visible logos or extraneous text.
